title: Kosher Umami Japanese Pork Okonomiyaki
description: A savory and umami-rich Japanese okonomiyaki dish featuring pork and kosher-friendly ingredients, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the rendered lardons to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced pork shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the shredded cabbage and chopped scallions to the skillet and cook until the cabbage is wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the okonomiyaki sauce, mayonnaise, bonito flakes, and Worcestershire sauce.
Pour the sauce mixture over the pork and cabbage mixture in the skillet.
Top the mixture with the crispy lardons and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the okonomiyaki hot, garnished with additional scallions and bonito flakes if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
